notice: The History Club presents Archive After Dark, an evening conversation with Mira Sen, on 8 October 2027 at East Hall.
The Computing Association invites students to its annual event, Data Day: Beyond the Grid, on 9 October 2027 in Lab 4.
The Student Union, organizer of the annual campus gathering, welcomes students to Lantern Market on 10 October 2027 at the Quad.
Who Owns the Moon? Hosted by the Astronomy Society on 11 October 2027 in Observatory Hall.
The campus calendar first listed the Civic Design Forum for 12 October 2027. The organizer later issued a correction: the forum is rescheduled to 14 October 2027. Venue: North Auditorium.
The department calendar lists the Marine Science Lecture for 15 October 2027. The student society bulletin lists 16 October 2027. Neither notice says that one date replaces the other. Venue: Room 12.
The Robotics Club's registration deadline is 17 October 2027. Its event, Circuit Sprint, takes place on 19 October 2027 at Workshop Bay.
The Literature Society announces Stories in Transit for 20 October 2027 at Reading Room. An update from the society says, “Correction: the event will be held on 21 October 2027.”
The campus listing places the Public Health Panel in West Hall. The organizer's notice places it in South Hall. Neither source identifies an update or priority. Date: 22 October 2027.
The Biology Society first announced Field Notes Workshop in Garden Room. A later correction from the society says the workshop has moved to Greenhouse Annex. Date: 23 October 2027.
The Philosophy Club will hold Ethics in Practice on 24 October 2027. The venue will be announced after registration.
The Geography Society hosts Mapmaking for Everyone on 25 October 2027 in Room 204 of the East Learning Center.
